prompt_en: A summer fashion photograph catches a single connected incident at a canal-side secondhand bookstall on a warm late-summer afternoon. The main subject is a woman. Use the supplied photograph for visible face and hair guidance: the softly shaped face, dark eyes, short dark bob and fine separated fringe inform her appearance in this newly invented situation. Her clothing, bodily staging and circumstances belong to this scene. A sudden breeze has raised the near corner of an opened tourist map on a waist-high wooden sorting table. She presses the map flat with her left palm while her right hand lowers a smooth oval stone paperweight toward the lifted corner; the paper already flattened beneath her fingers contrasts with the remaining raised edge. One loose paper label lies on the dry paving beside a stack of worn guidebooks, and two other labels remain under a glass jar on the table. These small traces explain why she is acting now. She glances toward the troublesome corner, lips parted in a brief concentrated response, caught just before the stone makes the rest of the map usable again. She wears a sky-blue linen V-neck wrap midi dress. Its overlapping front panels make a clean diagonal across the fitted bodice into a fabric waist tie at her left side. Short flutter sleeves hang loosely from both shoulder seams; on her dress, the flutter sleeve has a loose flared lower edge highlighted by the side light. Along its underside, its fabric hangs away from the upper arm, leaving a readable air space in this moment. From the stitched shoulder attachment down to that perimeter, the flutter sleeve free edge flares away from the upper arm on the same sky-blue dress. Beneath the knot, the dress side edges widen toward the lower hem in one uninterrupted sweep; seen beside the straight table leg, the skirt forms a clear A-shaped outline around her planted stance. The overlapping wrap panels end at two visibly different heights to form a staggered asymmetrical hem below the knees. Fine linen texture and a few soft movement folds belong to the same garment. Two separate fine silver chain necklaces make nested arcs at her upper chest, a short chain near the collarbones and a longer chain with a small round pendant below it, both visible inside the V opening. A small honey-colored woven shoulder bag rests at her outside left hip, its narrow brown leather strap passing over her left shoulder and visibly joining the bag at each upper side. Her low-wedge espadrille sandals have tan crossing toe straps, slim ties encircling each ankle and rough woven-jute wedge edges beneath both heels. Both feet stay planted on the dry paving with a relaxed stagger and slightly bent knees as she makes a small forward inclination from the hips; her elbows remain comfortably bent over the reachable table edge. The table sits beside her right side, leaving her dress front, hem, bag and both sandals visible. Frame her from the top of her bob to the paving beneath both soles, from a front three-quarter position at chest height with a natural normal-lens perspective. The table and the hands occupy the right side of the photograph; the pale-blue dress is the largest continuous shape against the muted cream stall and the green canal behind. Soft side light reveals the cloth overlap, necklace separation and jute edges while preserving the quieter background. The moving paper and sleeve ends share the breeze; the stable stance anchors a graceful, practical summer interruption.
